sources.title: TenseMusic: An automatic prediction model for musical tension
sources.read_depth: full text archived/extracted; sections read: pp. 1-5 model/features and pp. 12-16 results, limitations, conclusion
sources.page_or_section_anchors: Automatic feature extraction; slope estimation; 38 classical excerpts; public Python/OSF artifacts
sources.strongest_evidence: Un modello audio-input usa sei feature, trend e memoria per stimare tensione su estratti classici; una curva in calo non certifica una risoluzione di mix.
sources.transfer_limit: Classica e singolo estratto; nessun cross-song, nessuna voce rap, nessun giudizio DJ.

sources.title: SongEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Generated Music
sources.authors: authors as published in arXiv record
sources.license: arXiv open access; dataset/model terms separate
sources.access: local PDF (13 pages; pypdf-validated) and extracted root text
sources.read_depth: full text archived/extracted; sections read: dataset, five expert-rated dimensions, limitations
sources.page_or_section_anchors: Dataset and five expert-rated dimensions; local V10 diagnostic run; limitations on whole-song vs transition quality
sources.strongest_evidence: Benchmark di canzoni generate con dimensioni estetiche separate, utile come rubrica di coerenza/fraseggio ma non come filtro automatico di un singolo raccordo.
sources.transfer_limit: Whole-song ratings ≠ A→B transition labels; evitare leakage e non addestrare sulle valutazioni V8/V10.
